metadata.purpose: Repeat on source completion, controlled by a single persistent notifier and completion Subject.

conditions: Each source next forwards once; a source completion emits one void notification on the completion Subject.
Notifier next while waiting starts one new source; notifier completion ends repetition after any active source completes.
Source or notifier error terminates immediately. Cancellation silently releases both subscriptions.

scope.parameters: One notifier function returning a non-synchronously-emitting Observable; selector called exactly once after first source completion.
scope.callbacks: Notifier selector is represented by its successful Observable result; callback throws/invalid inputs are excluded.
scope.time: Source notifications and notifier next/complete/error carry their own times; no new clock is introduced.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-subscription notifications; notifier next is only admitted while waiting after a source completion.
exclusions: Synchronous notifier next or complete during its original subscription, source subscription setup recursion and syncResub flag mechanics.
Notifier next while a source is already active (can start overlapping source executions), Promise inputs and arbitrary reentrancy.
Notifier selector throws, teardown throws and notifier emissions following terminal notification.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One initial source; lazily create completion Subject and one notifier subscription at first successful completion.

ownership.sharing: The completion Subject is internal to one result subscription; it is not multicast among downstream subscribers.
ownership.reset: New downstream subscription creates a new notifier selector/Subject when first needed.

resources.owner: persistent notifier created on first source completion

dispatch.actionSemantics: Completion signals go to internal Subject, not the downstream. Notifier next triggers a new source subscription; no value is invented.
cancellationCheckpoints: After each notification, before new source acquisition and while awaiting notifier next.

controls.description: source running, notifier may be absent/open/completed
source completed; persistent notifier awaiting next or terminal

rules.explanation: Notifier selector has not yet been invoked: it is lazy until the first successful source completion.
The notifier only governs repetition; values from every successful attempt reach the downstream observer.
rules.nextState: Current generation and notifier state unchanged.

rules.guard: current source completes, and notifier has never been constructed
rules.explanation: On first completion allocate the Subject, invoke the user notifier exactly once and subscribe its result; notify it of the completion.
rules.nextState: Waiting for first notifier next or terminal notification.

rules.guard: current source completes and notifier is still open
actions: emit one void completion Subject signal
rules.explanation: Subsequent completions reuse the same Subject and notifier subscription, not a fresh notifier selector call.
rules.nextState: Waiting with the notifier still open.

rules.guard: current source completes after notifier has completed
rules.explanation: If the notifier has already completed, downstream completes when the current source finally completes.
rules.nextState: Closed successfully; no source or notifier connection.

rules.guard: notifier is open and source has completed
rules.explanation: Every notifier next while waiting restarts exactly one new producer execution; notifier connection is retained.

rules.guard: notifier completes with main source finished
rules.explanation: An empty/finished notifier ends the repetition while waiting; it does not subscribe a new source.

rules.guard: notifier completes while restarted source is still active
actions: release notifier without terminating current source
rules.explanation: Notifier completion is recorded. Do not interrupt the current source: completion awaits its own successful termination.
Notifier error terminates the result whether waiting or inside a restarted source execution.
